title: Understanding Accuracy
text: Accuracy is the ratio of correctly predicted observations to the total observations. Think about how many predictions match the true labels.

title: Counting Correct Predictions
text: Count how many times the predicted value matches the true label. This will give you the number of correct predictions.

title: Calculate the Accuracy
text: Now that you know the number of correct predictions, divide it by the total number of predictions to find the accuracy.
